rationale: Combines volatility-gated momentum from vol_gated_momentum_mut_1 with volume conviction from alpha-liquidity-v1-002-mut-001. The primary mechanism is continuous volatility weighting of short-term return; the lightweight modifier is relative volume to enhance signal in high-volume regimes. This crossover targets improving IC and ICIR while preserving the strong RankICIR and MI of the volatility parent.
